column5: Main narrows the spec to the shared Vega-Lite engine reached via the dashboard-widgets drawer after the standalone workbench page was removed - exactly this branch's architecture (sandboxed-iframe dashboard-widget authoring + saved-chart persistence/validation), so the containment/theming/accessibility/granularity behaviour it describes is covered under the new surface.

Evaluator-attachment additions (evaluatorAttachmentsWireSchema, suite_field_in_use/suite_evaluator_not_found/suite_evaluator_mapping_invalid) are already covered in modules/suite's rewrite, but main's server-side voice-target gate (assertVoiceTargetsAllowed / VoiceAgentsDisabledError, refusing a "voice" target when release_voice_agents_enabled is off) has no equivalent in modules/suite/server - the wire schema accepts "voice" as a target type with no flag check before create/update.

Main's only change here is the dataset-row search feature (#7731: normalizeDatasetSearch/matchesDatasetSearch/DatasetTooLargeToSearchError); this branch already has that as modules/dataset/server/src/services/dataset-search.ts wired into dataset.service.ts, with its own unit tests.

Main added seek-based one-item-at-a-time queue navigation (queueWalkOrder/queueWalkNeighbourhood/QUEUE_WALK_LOOKAHEAD, fixing a skip/duplicate bug in offset paging) plus a related tenancy-guard fix keeping projectId top-level; this branch's prisma.annotation-queue-item.repository.ts still pages the queue with plain skip/take and has no next-item walk method at all (projectId is already top-level here, so only the walk feature/fix is missing, not the tenancy fix).

The reserved-set-write-guard (assertWritableSetId/ScenarioReservedSetIdError) main kept is already ported verbatim into scenario.trpc.ts; most of the diff is main's own internal refactor (extracting launchScenarioRun), and I could not confirm from this file alone whether the two feature commits behind it (status-page run-liveness proof, and suite-evaluators wired onto scenario runs) are reachable through this branch's scenario.trpc.ts - needs a look at launch-scenario-run coverage specifically.

Confirmed by this branch's own code comment ("THE ALERT BELL DID NOT TRAVEL... both entry points - Add alert and the bell that edits an existing one - called openDrawer(\"automation\", ...)"): graph-card-header.tsx has no add-alert/edit-alert bell wired to the automations drawer, and also lacks the EditableWidgetName inline-rename control and stripPackPrefix/deriveDisplayName "North-star:"/"Legacy:" name handling that main added.

Main wrapped the alert-banner stack in a positioned `zIndex="docked"` layer so banners draw above page content that bleeds over them (a page's own z-indexed containers, or the home hero's bloom, were washing banner text out); shell-page-body.tsx still renders its Alert.Root banners directly inside the plain `<VStack>` with no positioning/z-index wrapper, so the same stacking bug is still present.

Both source commits (#7870 sandboxed chart widgets, #7331 self-provisioning on helm install/upgrade) are covered: the provisioning task moved to modules/analytics/server/src/tasks/lwql-provision.task.ts, and selfProvisioning.ts/selfProvisionLock.ts/productionProvisioning.ts implement the self-provisioning-by-default behaviour with their own tests.

The saved-workbench-charts endpoint was ported to modules/analytics/server/src/transport/saved-workbench-chart.rest.ts, but the only test touching it is a route-declaration unit test (langwatch-ql-rest.declaration.unit.test.ts); the behavioural integration coverage main's 262-line test provided (create/run/permission/validation scenarios) has no equivalent on this branch.

This branch has an extensive dedicated voice-agent stack (voice-concurrency-gate.ts, voice-worker-only.ts, voice-agent.adapter.ts, node-scenario-child-process.service.ts, plus the contract's voice/ session/handoff/limits modules) that supersedes main's two commits here (voice agents v1, and its services/HandledError refactor) - the child-process launch responsibility moved to node-scenario-child-process.service.ts.

This branch has a dedicated trace-list.repository.version-dedup.integration.test.ts covering exactly the "derives the version dedup twice per page" fix, alongside trace-list.repository.ts as the rewritten repository.

column4: apps/worker/src/app/*.composition.ts + each module's own app/service wiring
column5: This file is the old monolith's dependency-injection composition root (wires ClickHouse repositories, webhooks, langy, analytics services together); main's edits here are wiring for capabilities this branch already implements natively (voice-agent stack, suite evaluators) or that belong to the governance port (agent discovery/sync, #8043 - out of this lane's scope) - the wiring itself is superseded by the per-module composition roots (apps/worker/src/app/*.composition.ts and each module's own app/*.ts), not a standalone capability to port.

Both source commits (#8043 discover/sync agents from providers, #7650 adr-128 pulled-rows/leak-gate/cost-rollup) are governance-port work, same family as the excluded ingestion-pull-processing/ee-governance set even though this path does not literally match that exclusion regex; better classified by the governance lane, which has the context for what in ee/governance already covers pulled-usage-processing schemas.

SuiteFieldIdentifierInvalidError/DuplicateError, SuiteFieldInUseError, SuiteEvaluatorNotFoundError and SuiteEvaluatorMappingInvalidError are all present in modules/suite/contract/src/suite-evaluators.ts, but VoiceAgentsDisabledError and SuiteEvaluatorMappingsMissingError are not defined anywhere in modules/suite - same voice-target-gating gap already found in suite.service.ts.

The online/offline connected-agent presence model (assertConnectedAgentsOnline in main) is already implemented via the ConnectedPresenceReader/resolveConnectedReference pattern in connected-target.service.ts - filters candidates to online status, prefers the development environment, and resolves personal-agent ownership - just under different names.

Both behaviours are ported: apps/api/src/features/health/scenario-canary.service.ts authenticates the scenario canary against projectId (multitenancy-guard satisfied), and modules/gateway/server/src/transport has langy-canary.integration.test.ts covering GET /api/health/langy as a public, in-handler-authenticated endpoint - matching the "real greeting" health check.

suite-wire-v1.rules.ts and suite-evaluators.ts implement the evaluator-attachment domain logic, but none of modules/suite's transport integration tests (suite-run.rest.integration.test.ts, test-suites.rest.integration.test.ts, run-plans.rest.integration.test.ts) mention evaluators at all - the end-to-end "evaluators run after every scenario run" behaviour main's test proved has no equivalent integration coverage here.

Same gap as test-suite-run.integration.test.ts: the suite-fields-and-evaluators feature (#7867) has domain-level error classes and wire schema in modules/suite/contract, but no transport-level integration test in modules/suite exercises creating/updating a suite with evaluator attachments.

The scenario-evaluations job dispatch main wired into pipelineRegistry.ts (runScenarioEvaluations, scenarioEvaluations.job, RecordEvaluationsCommand) is fully present on this branch under modules/scenario's own eventing/subscribers/projections, each with its own unit/integration tests.

VOICE_WORKER_ONLY boot mode (a worker that boots only the voice-scoped scenario processor + voice-ws-listener) is implemented in worker-boot-plan.ts with its own unit test, and the voice-filtered execution pool has modules/scenario/server/src/__tests__/execution-pool-voice-filter.unit.test.ts.

Main's voice-agents-v1 endpoint (test an ElevenLabs agent from the app, then its HandledError refactor) landed in modules/scenario rather than modules/agent - voice-concurrency-gate.ts references ElevenLabs directly and sits alongside voice-agent.adapter.ts and the rest of the voice call stack; modules/agent's own trpc transport has no voice references at all, confirming the capability moved module rather than being dropped.

Main wires the parent-side voice nonce handoff (registerVoiceNonceHandoffListener listens for a spawned voice child's IPC message and acks it via getVoiceNonceRegistry, so the child can register its Twilio stream nonce) into the scenario processor's child-process spawn path; on this branch voice-nonce-registry.ts exists in modules/scenario/contract but nothing in scenario-processor.service.ts, node-scenario-child-process.service.ts or child-process-spawn.service.ts calls it - the registry is defined but never wired to a spawned child.

Main's addition here is resolving voice agent/caller-voice config during data prefetch (parseVoiceAgentConfig, parseCallerVoiceConfig, voiceCallMaxSeconds); all three functions exist and are called on this branch, just at voice-session setup time in voice-session.ports.ts rather than during scenario-data prefetch - same capability, different pipeline stage.

The chart-grid placement bounds validation (chartGridPlacementSchema/fitsChartGridWidth/CHART_GRID_DEFAULT_COL_SPAN, refusing a colSpan+gridColumn combination that overflows the grid) is present in chartGrid.ts and used by dashboardWidget.service.ts, with its own chartGrid.unit.test.ts.

The turn-preparation logic split into ~13 langy-turn-*.service.ts files on this branch; LangySkillNotAvailableError exists in modules/langy/contract/src/langy.errors.ts, but I could not locate skillGateFlagFor/disabledSkillIds/LANGY_SKILL_CATALOGUE_IDS (the per-turn flag-gated skill exclusion main added) in the files checked (langy-turn.service.ts, langy-turn-preparation.service.ts) - needs a wider search across the full turn-service split before calling it a gap.

Same finding as health-checks.ts: modules/gateway/server/src/transport has langy-canary.integration.test.ts proving GET /api/health/langy exists as a public, in-handler-authenticated route sending Langy a real greeting - the route this file used to register.

Department assignment (managing departments, DepartmentPicker linked into the members and teams screens rather than a standalone list) is implemented via DepartmentPicker/useDepartmentColumn, wired into both members.screen.tsx and teams.screen.tsx behind a governanceEnabled + organization-manage-permission gate.

Both source commits (#8043 discover/sync agents from providers, #7650 adr-128 pulled-rows/leak-gate/cost-rollup) are governance-port work; same as pulled-usage-processing/schemas/events.ts, better classified by the governance lane even though the path itself does not match the literal exclusion regex.

Same evaluator-integration-coverage gap as the other two suite test files: the REST test-suites API integration tests on this branch do not exercise evaluator attachments, only the field/CRUD behaviour that predates #7867.

The target/agent-type selector was renamed and its voice-target coverage ported: TargetSelectorOffline.integration.test.tsx has a "given a voice target is selected" describe block exercising the voice option end to end.

No unit test on this branch (searched modules/scenario/server's agent-test-run/test-run unit tests) exercises evaluators being invoked as part of running an individual agent test the way main's agent-test-run.unit.test.ts does - the evaluator domain logic is unit-tested in isolation (suite-evaluators.unit.test.ts) but not against the agent-test-run flow specifically.
Part of the #7870 sandboxed-chart-widgets commit, the same LWQL/dashboard-widgets area already confirmed extensively ported (langwatch-ql/, saved-workbench-chart.rest.ts, chartGrid.ts).

Narrow correctness fix (#7710: answer the user cohort from the user's own memberships) - not checked against modules/*/server system-migration/enrollment logic; needs a dedicated look rather than a guess.

Evaluator-aware simulation-run repository/mapper code exists (simulation-evaluations.columns.ts, simulation-run.evaluation-pending.unit.test.ts), covering the #7867 evaluators-on-scenario-runs data model this integration test exercised.
Router ported to the REST transport at saved-workbench-chart.rest.ts (see the paired test-file verdict for the one confirmed gap: no behavioural integration test for it yet).
Narrow fix (#7985: scope personal workspace lookup to the selected organization) - not checked against this branch's CLI-auth-redirect flow; needs a dedicated look.
Fix is #7932 "expose collection health and ingestion outcomes" - not checked against this branch's event-sourcing/process-manager metrics; needs a dedicated look.

Same evidence as simulation.clickhouse.repository.integration.test.ts above - evaluator-aware simulation-run-state repository code and tests exist under modules/scenario/server/src/repositories/clickhouse.
#7959 "connected agent drawer test turn takes parameter overrides" - not checked against modules/agent or modules/scenario's test-turn flow; needs a dedicated look.

Two source commits (#8040 voice drawer-vs-scenario trace/run split, #7867 evaluators); the surrounding voice and evaluator infrastructure is largely ported elsewhere in modules/scenario and modules/suite, but this specific service's "drawer calls write traces only, scenario calls keep writing runs" branching was not directly verified.
#7867 evaluators - repository/mapper level coverage exists (simulation-run.evaluation-pending.unit.test.ts) but end-to-end scenarios-REST-API coverage of evaluators was not directly checked.

#7867 evaluators - the scenario-evaluations job/eventing side is confirmed ported (modules/scenario/server/src/eventing), but this specific service file's own evaluator-triggering responsibility was not directly diffed and checked.

Of the two source commits, #7331 (LWQL self-provisioning on helm install/upgrade) is confirmed ported to selfProvisioning.ts/selfProvisionLock.ts; #7650 is governance-port work, out of this lane's scope.
#8013 "reject aggregation not allowed for metric in getTimeseries" - a specific validation fix, not checked against modules/analytics's own getTimeseries/aggregation validation.

Consistent with the suite.service.ts verdict above: this branch's suite service still lacks the server-side voice-target feature-flag gate (assertVoiceTargetsAllowed/VoiceAgentsDisabledError) that main's voice-agents-v1 unit tests here would have covered.
Governance-adjacent (#7650 adr-128) ClickHouse connection-pool change; not checked against this branch's connection-pool code, and may partly belong to the governance lane.
Direct port target exists with the same responsibility.
Same online/offline presence model already confirmed in connected-target.service.ts (see connected-targets.unit.test.ts verdict above) covers the integration-level behaviour too.
Governance-adjacent (#7650 adr-128) metrics addition; not checked, may partly belong to the governance lane.
Direct port target exists with the same responsibility.

Both source commits are governance features (#8033 Inventory catalog rebuild, #7650 adr-128); this specific route-registration file was not checked, and governance route registration likely belongs to the governance lane.
This branch replaced Biome with oxlint + oxfmt entirely (see CLAUDE.md); main's biome.jsonc edits have no target because the tool itself is gone, not because the file was merely moved.
